dedupe_keys.name: smart meter water consumption measurements additional evaluation data

description: Sebastian Wilhelm and colleagues at Deggendorf Institute of Technology publish labelled evaluation data from German household water meters. The February 2023 release contains separate activity and out-of-house ZIP packages, free under CC BY 4.0. Activity trials record thirty-second tap use and toilet flushes, separated by at least five minutes without concurrent consumption. A second experiment pairs readings with resident absence diaries in two homes, including whether appliances operated while occupants were away. CSV files provide meter readings, activity times or absence periods, with household information. These labels can calibrate demand-event or occupancy inference used in water-service simulations. Exact collection dates, meter sampling interval and diary uncertainty remain unknown. The related earlier-review draft data-smart-meter-water-consumption-measurements covers the main seventeen-household dataset, not this separately described evaluation set. No files or privacy-inference performance were independently tested.
